decision: Stored date of birth and course-start reference date remain the sole sources for persisted age/minor calculations. No schema change, cached age, invented birthday or migration change.

presentation.profile: Remove the duplicate date-of-birth display; retain the existing derived age and its edit shortcut.
presentation.scanReview: Age is the primary field. The exact date is exposed only when it is missing, doubtful, or conflicts with the reviewed age; saving remains blocked until that exact date is valid.
presentation.manualCreateAndEdit: Exact-date input remains because manual creation has no second reading to corroborate it and the date is required by the domain contract.

corroboration: Read an explicit number followed by anni/anno independently from the date. At course start, difference at most one year corroborates confidence, without modifying either reading or MIN_FIELD_CONFIDENCE. Invalid/future dates do not corroborate. Without age, date confidence behaves as before.
limit: Agreement corroborates age, not the day or month. Exact-date minor rules still use the retained date.
ageOnlyAndCorrectionRule: Request the exact date before persistence. The app never invents a day or month and never stores an approximate birthday. This preserves the 0.1.0 data contract and the owner's instruction that the date remains the source of minor/adult rules.
